name: Earned Reverence
label: Quest
description: Earned Reverence: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So many slain. Blood drenches the fields. Yet... You live... You have persevered. You have led our armies to many victories. For this, then, soldier, you have earned a new rank.

clips.title: Completion
paras: They have already begun telling tales of your deeds, soldier. The Stormpike shakes in fear when your name is uttered. Carry on!
